items.label: None
items.prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic luxury menswear product photography.

A clean studio DOCUMENTATION photograph of the deliberate ABSENCE of a feature. Underarm Shield: "None". The clean, unbroken area where the underarm shield would be IS the subject, identifiable within one second. PROVE THE ABSENCE — do not merely omit the feature. Frame the exact place on the garment where the underarm shield would sit if this option had one, large enough in the picture that a viewer could not miss it were it there, and include enough surrounding construction — seams, edges, the matching position on the opposite side — that the viewer can recognise WHERE they are looking. Light that surface so a underarm shield, if present, would break the plane or throw a shadow: a flatly-lit or shadowed surface proves nothing, because the feature would be invisible there whether or not it existed. The picture must let a customer conclude "there is none here", not merely fail to show one.

A premium bespoke sport coat featuring a precise None (Underarm Shield).

Intent: No underarm shield.

This option is the ABSENCE of the underarm shield.

MANDATORY — do NOT render a underarm shield. Reproduce a clean garment with no underarm shield, exactly as the illustration shows; adding the feature is a failure.

VIEW — this illustration is the interior of the garment. Photograph the same face; never substitute a different face of the garment.

BLUEPRINT LOCK — THE DRAWING IS LAW: the attached technical illustration is the manufacturing blueprint for this exact craft option and the SOLE authority for the image. Reproduce its geometry precisely — point/edge shape, lengths, widths, depths, angles, curvature, roll lines, symmetry, button/tab/stay positions, seam and stitch placement, and proportions — within less than 2% deviation. Assume NOTHING from tailoring/menswear/fashion convention or model priors; every visible characteristic must come from the drawing. Do not redesign, reinterpret, substitute a similar commercial style, stylise, or "improve" it. Do NOT fall back to a generic version of this category — reproduce THIS option, not a typical one. If convention conflicts with the drawing, the drawing wins. Accuracy over aesthetics. ANNOTATIONS ARE NOT THE GARMENT: the technical drawing may carry measurement callouts — dimension numbers ("2.5cm", "9cm", "115°"), tick / leader / dimension lines, arrows, red or coloured guide marks, and text labels. These are manufacturing documentation, NOT features of the cloth. Reproduce ONLY the finished garment: never render any number, unit, arrow, callout, leader line, measurement mark, or text anywhere in the photograph. The final image is a clean garment photo with zero annotation. COLOUR IN THE DRAWING IS NOTATION, NOT CLOTH: any red, orange or otherwise highlighted region marks WHERE the craft option sits — it is a position marker, never a colour specification. Flat grey or tinted shading marks the EXTENT of a panel, lining or facing, not its shade. There must be no red, no highlighter tint and no flat unshaded grey panel anywhere in the photograph unless the option's own label explicitly names that colour.

A premium bespoke sport coat featuring a precise Italian Card Slot (Ticket Pocket).

Its restraint makes it especially appropriate on slim, structured city suits in fine worsted.

Exact specification — on the right side ONLY — do not mirror or swap. VIEW — this illustration is the front of the garment. Photograph the same face; never substitute a different face of the garment.

BLUEPRINT LOCK — THE DRAWING IS LAW: the attached technical illustration is the manufacturing blueprint for this exact craft option and the SOLE authority for the image. Do not redesign, reinterpret, substitute a similar commercial style, stylise, or "improve" it. Do NOT fall back to a generic version of this category — reproduce THIS option, not a typical one.
